# Refund policy

Annual plan refunds are allowed when a workspace cancels within 30 days of the
renewal charge. Agents issue a prorated credit back to the original payment
method after confirming there was no policy abuse.

Monthly plans are not prorated after the current billing period has started.
Usage-based add-ons are excluded from refund eligibility because they represent
resources already consumed.

When a customer asks what rule controls annual cancellations, link this policy
before using any ticket macro.
